findings.source: Doctor: Уже светало. Я собирался домой, как вдруг меня окликнул один из КЧС-ников.
findings.currentTarget: Doctor: Alfajiri ilikuwa inakaribia. Nilikuwa naenda nyumbani, ghafla mmoja wa watu wa KHD akaniita.
findings.proposedFullTarget: Doctor: Tayari kulikuwa kunapambazuka. Nilikuwa naenda nyumbani, ghafla mmoja wa watu wa KHD akaniita.
findings.objectiveReason: Source says it was already getting light; target says dawn was approaching. Preserve the already-dawning time boundary in the escape story.
The explicit referent is nyumba in the immediately preceding unit. aungue denotes an animate person burning instead of the house (iungue).

findings.source: Greatmother: Детки, ползите сюда, я здесь. Ползите сюда, я нашла новый дом.
findings.currentTarget: Greatmother: Wanangu, tambaeni mje hapa, niko hapa. Tambaa mje hapa, nimepata nyumba mpya.
findings.proposedFullTarget: Greatmother: Wanangu, tambaeni mje hapa, niko hapa. Tambaeni mje hapa, nimepata nyumba mpya.
findings.objectiveReason: Both commands address her plural children, explicit Wanangu and matching plural mje. Second Tambaa is singular and contradicts this address.

findings.source: Greatmother: Ползите сюда, ему этот дом больше не пригодится.
findings.currentTarget: Greatmother: Tambaa mje hapa, yeye hataihitaji tena nyumba hii.
findings.proposedFullTarget: Greatmother: Tambaeni mje hapa, yeye hataihitaji tena nyumba hii.
findings.objectiveReason: The command addresses her plural children from the preceding unit, not the player. Singular Tambaa conflicts with plural mje and the Russian plural command.
